title: Spiral Matrix
contract: Return a nonempty rectangular matrix in clockwise spiral order starting at the top-left.
brute: int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length;boolean[][] seen=new boolean[rows][cols];int[][] directions={{0,1},{1,0},{0,-1},{-1,0}};int r=0,c=0,d=0;List<Integer> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<rows*cols;i++){out.add(grid[r][c]);seen[r][c]=true;int nr=r+directions[d][0],nc=c+directions[d][1];if(nr<0||nr>=rows||nc<0||nc>=cols||seen[nr][nc])d=(d+1)%4;r+=directions[d][0];c+=directions[d][1];emit("Walk and turn at a visited cell or boundary","output",out);}return out;
optimal: int top=0,bottom=grid.length-1,left=0,right=grid[0].length-1;List<Integer> out=new ArrayList<>();while(top<=bottom&&left<=right){for(int c=left;c<=right;c++)out.add(grid[top][c]);top++;for(int r=top;r<=bottom;r++)out.add(grid[r][right]);right--;if(top<=bottom){for(int c=right;c>=left;c--)out.add(grid[bottom][c]);bottom--;}if(left<=right){for(int r=bottom;r>=top;r--)out.add(grid[r][left]);left++;}emit("Peel one boundary layer","remaining bounds",new int[]{top,bottom,left,right},"output",out);}return out;
reasoning: Simulate a moving cursor with a visited matrix to decide when to turn.
Maintain the four boundaries of the unvisited rectangle and peel one side at a time.
Recheck the row/column bounds before traversing the bottom and left sides, preventing duplicates in a single remaining row or column. The optimization saves visited storage, not traversal time.
